description: The dollar sank, deepening a four-day selloff that’s sent it to the lowest since early 2022, after President Donald Trump indicated he’s comfortable with those declines. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Trump Says He’s Not Concerned About Dollar Slump

author: Hadriana Lowenkron
description: President Donald Trump threw his support behind a legislative proposal that would expand sales of higher-ethanol E15 gasoline as he looked to build support for his economic record with a crowd that included farmers in Iowa.
title: Trump in Ethanol-Friendly Iowa Pushes for Bill Boosting E15 Gasoline

description: Karim Sadjadpour, Carnegie Endowment for International Peace Senior Fellow, discusses whether or not the US may strike Iran as the United States' naval carrier strike group has arrived in the Middle East. He also talks about the status of Iran's nuclear program and his reaction to Trump's "Board of Peace." Karim speaks with Joe Mathieu on the late edition of Bloomberg's "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)
title: US Iran Strategy Similar to Venezuela: Sadjadpour

author: Eric Martin
description: Secretary of State Marco Rubio said the Trump administration is prepared to use force to ensure that Venezuela’s acting President Delcy Rodríguez cooperates to the greatest extent possible with the US, while hoping that self-interest will motivate her to advance key American objectives.
title: Rubio Says US Ready to Use Force to Ensure Venezuela’s Cooperation

description: Donell Harvin, former DC Chief of Homeland Security & Intelligence, suggests that hopefully there will be a reset and a withdrawal of ICE agents when discussing the Trump Administration sending Tom Homan to Minnesota. Harvin also talks about whether or not US DHS Secretary Kristi Noem should keep her job, and his thoughts on sanctuary cities when it comes to immigration & the federal government. He speaks with Joe Mathieu on the late edition of Bloomberg's "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Reset Needed at the Very Top: Harvin on DHS, ICE, Trump

description: CEOs like Sam Altman and Jamie Dimon are breaking their political silence after the unrest in Minneapolis. But are they saying enough, Bloomberg Opinion columnist Beth Kowitt asks. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: What CEOs Have Said About ICE

description: Alli McCartney, Managing Director of Wealth Management with Alignment Partners at UBS, joins Bloomberg Businessweek Daily to discuss markets news of day, including how investors are shifting their strategy as President Trump unleashes a barrage of geopolitical changes to begin the year. McCartney also weighs in on this week's Fed decision and how tech earnings could impact markets. She speaks with Carol Massar and Tim Stenovec. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Market's Geopolitical Risk Tolerance Has Shifted: UBS's McCartney

description: Boeing Co. generated cash for a second straight quarter and reported a 57% bump in sales during the final three months of 2025, as the US planemaker continues its recovery and benefits from surging orders. Free cash flow was $375 million in the fourth quarter, more than analysts expected, while revenue rose to $23.95 billion. Earnings were boosted by a $9.6 billion gain tied to the sale of Boeing’s Jeppesen digital aviation subsidiary last year. Jefferies Equity Research Managing Director Sheila Kahyaoglu joins Bloomberg Businessweek Daily to discuss. She speaks with Carol Massar and Tim Stenovec.  (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Boeing Cash, Sales Rise After Most Jet Deliveries Since 2018

author: Brendan Murray, Lucy White, Alex Wickham
description: UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer arrives in Beijing on Wednesday confident he can do what few leaders have shown the political dexterity to pull off: broaden trade ties with China without annoying President Donald Trump.
title: Starmer Wants UK Plc to Win Over China’s Xi Without Annoying Trump

author: Josh Wingrove
description: India has more work to do in order to satisfy US concerns about its purchases of Russian oil and secure tariff relief, President Donald Trump’s trade representative said.
title: India Must Do More to Wind Down Russian Oil Buys, Greer Says

description: Pimco's Libby Cantrill says the US dollar is still dominant and serves as the world's reserve currency. The Bloomberg Dollar Spot Index hit a new session low on Tuesday, falling as much as 1.2%, as the US currency weakened against all of its major counterparts.  (Source: Bloomberg)
title: The US Dollar Is Still Dominant, Cantrill Says

author: Erik Wasson
description: Senate Majority Leader John Thune said the two parties are in talks with the White House over US government funding as Democrats threaten to force a partial US government shutdown following a mounting public backlash over President Donald Trump’s immigration crackdown in Minnesota.
title: Lawmakers in Talks to Avoid Partial US Shutdown, Thune Says

description: President Donald Trump says he doesn't think the value of the US dollar has declined too much while talking with reporters in Iowa. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Trump Says US Dollar Is 'Doing Great'

author: David Finnerty, Vassilis Karamanis
description: The euro climbed above the 1.20 level against the dollar for the first time since June 2021 after President Donald Trump said he was not concerned with the US currency’s decline.
title: Euro Rallies Above $1.20 on Broad Dollar Weakness, Trump Remarks

author: Joe Sobczyk, Gregory Korte
description: Clashes at home and unfinished fights abroad keep overtaking the message.
title: Trump Tries, Again, to Refocus on Economy Amid Immigration Furor

description: On today's episode of Bloomberg Businessweek Daily, Carol Massar and Tim Stenovec discuss stocks approaching record highs as the dollar's rout continues. Bloomberg's Carter Johnson joins the show to discuss, and Alli McCartney of UBS Alignment Partners weighs in on market moves just ahead of Wednesday's Federal Reserve decision. Then, Sheila Kahyaoglu of Jefferies joins to discuss Boeing delivery plans and the overall state of the aerospace industry, and Bloomberg's Jen Dlouhy discusses how the Trump administration is shifting its reaction to Minnesota unrest as CEOs continue weighing in publicly. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Dollar's 'Relentless' Slide, More CEOs Respond to MN Unrest | Bloomberg Businessweek Daily 1/27/2026

author: Josh Wingrove, Hadriana Lowenkron, Carter Johnson
description: The dollar sank, deepening a four-day selloff that’s sent it to the lowest since early 2022, after President Donald Trump indicated he’s comfortable with those declines.
title: Trump Deepens Dollar Woes, Saying He’s Not Concerned About Slump

author: Jennifer A Dlouhy
description: President Donald Trump warned Iraq’s largest political bloc against tapping former Prime Minister Nouri al-Maliki to return to office, saying the US would “no longer help” the nation if he was back in power.
title: Trump Warns US Will No Longer Help Iraq If Al-Maliki Is Premier

author: Mark Chediak, Brian Dowling
description: A US judge said a nearly completed, $4.5 billion wind project off the coast of Massachusetts can resume construction weeks after the Trump administration required all such developments to stop work.
title: Judge Revives Martha’s Vineyard Wind Project Halted by Trump

author: Jennifer A Dlouhy, Josh Wingrove
description: The Trump administration is demanding that South Korea take concrete steps to implement its six-month-old trade deal with the US in order to prevent tariffs from rising to 25%, according to US officials.
title: US Trade Spat With South Korea Driven by Tech Laws, Gridlock

description: Jen Gavito, senior advisor at The Cohen Group and former-acting principal deputy assistant secretary of state for near eastern affairs under President Biden, said that a potential strike against Iranian leadership could open a 'can of worms' that the US is 'ill-prepared' to understand and deal with. Gavito said that a strike could give unpredictable results and have a destabilizing effect on the entire region.  (Source: Bloomberg)
title: US 'Ill-Prepared' To Deal With Fallout of Potential Strike on Iran Leadership, Says Jen Gavito

author: K Oanh Ha, Naomi Ng, Yang Yang (News)
description: On today’s Big Take Asia podcast, how a crash in Japan’s bond market sent shockwaves through global markets and what to expect next.
title: How Japan’s Bond Crash Left Global Markets on Edge

description: On the early edition of Balance of Power, Bloomberg Washington Correspondent Joe Mathieu discusses President Donald Trump's shifting strategy in Minnesota. On today's show, former Acting White House Chief of Staff Mick Mulvaney, Stonecourt Capital Partner Rick Davis, Harvard Kennedy School's Ash Center Visiting Democracy Fellow Jeanne Sheehan Zaino and Cohen Group Senior Advisor Jen Gavito. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Trump Backs Noem, Shifts Minnesota Plan | Balance of Power: Early Edition 01/27/2026

description: David Kochel, a republican strategist based in Iowa and owner of Redwave Strategies, says that the Trump administration knows that they need to 'turn a few things around' in the midterm landscape as the White House grapples with backlash to ICE shootings in Minneapolis. Kochul says that Iowa is a good place for the president to get economic messaging back on track since he has a broad base of support, thinking of Iowans as 'his people.' (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Trump White House Aims to Refocus Messaging on Affordability in Iowa Speech

author: Anthony Capaccio
description: Lockheed Martin Corp.’s record F-35 deliveries last year come with a caveat: Slightly less than half of the 191 jets the US accepted in its largest weapons program should have been delivered about two years ago, according to the Pentagon.
title: Lockheed’s Record F-35 Jet Deliveries Last Year Come With Caveat

description: Mick Mulvaney, acting White House chief of staff in Trump’s first term, said the administration's reset on its immigration crackdown is the most significant pivot Trump's ever made, and it's the right response to the public furor that's arisen over the killings of two US citizens in Minneapolis. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Trump Shifts Minnesota Strategy After Shooting Prompts Public Outcry

author: John Gittelsohn
description: President Donald Trump signed an executive order that allows the federal government to preempt state and local regulations in the recovery efforts of last year’s Los Angeles wildfires, blaming the destruction and its slow rebuilding on California’s authorities.
title: Trump Orders Federal Takeover of LA Wildfire Rebuilding Efforts

author: Jennifer A Dlouhy, Myles Miller
description: Donald Trump said Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem would remain in her post despite the president’s decision to reshuffle the leadership running his deportation effort in Minnesota following widespread outcry over the killing of two US citizens by federal agents.
title: Trump Backs Noem as Homan Revamps Minnesota Immigration Effort

author: William Horobin
description: Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu survived renewed attempts to oust him over his plans for France’s public finances, bringing the country a step closer to securing a 2026 budget.
title: France Closes In on Budget as Premier Survives Censure Votes

author: Aashna Shah
description: Rural and smaller urban transit systems are likely to be more exposed to adverse policy changes from the Trump administration because they rely more heavily on federal funding, according to Moody’s Ratings.
title: Moody’s Flags Risk to Rural Transit From Federal Funding Shifts

description: Former Kansas City Fed President Esther George says Chair Jerome Powell had no choice but to speak out after President Donald Trump's Justice Department served him with grand jury subpoenas. She speaks on "Bloomberg Surveillance." (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Powell Had No Choice But to Speak Out, George Says

author: Joe Lovinger
description: Texas Governor Greg Abbott ordered state agencies and public universities to immediately freeze new H-1B visa petitions, saying that taxpayer-funded jobs should go to Texans whenever possible.
title: Texas Governor Halts H-1B Hiring at State Colleges, Agencies

author: Augusta Saraiva
description: US population growth cooled significantly last year amid a sharp slowdown in immigration, according to new US Census Bureau data.
title: US Population Growth Slows Significantly Due to Less Immigration

author: Patrick Gillespie, Jonathan Gilbert
description: A flagship pipeline project championed by Javier Milei’s administration chose a foreign supplier over a local giant run by one Argentina’s richest men in a test of the president’s free-market vision to open up a protectionist economy.
title: Milei Spurns Argentine Billionaire as Indian Firm Wins Pipeline Bid

author: Alicia Diaz, Steven T. Dennis
description: Democratic Senator Raphael Warnock, the senior pastor of Atlanta’s historic Ebenezer Baptist Church, plans to travel to Minneapolis this week amid growing backlash to the killing of nurse Alex Pretti by a Border Patrol agent.
title: Democrats’ Warnock to Travel to Minneapolis Following Killing

description: If ICE agents can shoot civilians and never be held accountable, then we aren’t living under the rule of law. We’re living in a police state, says Bloomberg Opinion columnist and Harvard Law professor Noah Feldman. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: ICE Does Not Have Immunity Under the Law

author: Kamil Kowalcze
description: German Finance Minister Lars Klingbeil reiterated a call for smaller groups of European Union members to forge ahead with reforms to make the 27-nation bloc more competitive in an increasingly ruthless global environment.
title: German Finance Chief Advocates Two-Speed Europe to Boost Reforms

author: Alex Wickham, Josh Xiao
description: Xi Jinping’s purge of top Chinese generals has cost Western governments a key contact and deepened fears that the People’s Liberation Army is becoming even more walled-off from contact.
title: Diplomats Worry Xi’s Purge Will Curb Critical Contact With China

author: James Woolcock
description: Nigel Farage’s poll-leading Reform UK party said GB News presenter Matthew Goodwin will be its candidate for the special election in Gorton and Denton, the parliamentary seat where the governing Labour Party blocked Greater Manchester Mayor Andy Burnham from standing.
title: Farage Taps GB News Host for Seat Labour Mayor Burnham Wanted

author: William Horobin
description: French Finance Minister Roland Lescure urged his Group of Seven counterparts to refrain from unilateral action on Tuesday after Europe and the US clashed over Donald Trump’s tariff threats last week.
title: France’s Finance Minister Tells G-7 to Avoid Unilateral Measures

author: Will Standring, Joe Mayes
description: The UK government announced a support package to help British pubs with rising tax bills, the latest U-turn from Keir Starmer’s struggling administration.
title: UK Pubs Get Tax Break as Labour Makes Latest Budget U-Turn

author: Julian Lee
description: About 60 million barrels has been added to Russian crude at sea since August
title: Russian Oil Backed Up at Sea After India’s Refiners Step Away

author: Laura Dhillon Kane
description: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney said he stood by his Davos warning about great-power coercion in a call with President Donald Trump, pushing back on US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent’s account of the conversation.
title: Canada’s Carney Told Trump He Meant What He Said in Davos Speech

author: Michelle Kaske
description: Construction on a new $16 billion rail tunnel project connecting New Jersey and Manhattan will stop as soon as next week unless the federal government unlocks funds tied to the development.
title: Gateway Tunnel Work to Stop Next Week If White House Holds Funding

author: Alex Dooler, Lucy White
description: Nigel Farage hosted a private lunch event in Dubai on Tuesday with the backing of Indian billionaire Sunny Varkey, as his insurgent Reform UK party tries to win over more wealthy donors based in the United Arab Emirates.
title: Farage Pitches Dubai Elite Over Lunch in Push to Boost Donations

author: Michal Kubala
description: Czech President Petr Pavel accused the nation’s foreign minister of engaging in potential extortion over the head of state’s refusal to appoint the party’s candidate to the government.
title: Czech President Accuses Top Diplomat of Potential Extortion

author: Zoltan Simon
description: Hungarian opposition leader Peter Magyar made a pitch for rivals in the anti-government camp to stay out of this year’s parliamentary election as a way to concentrate the effort to unseat Prime Minister Viktor Orban with his party.
title: Magyar Seeks to Clear Opposition Field Before Hungary’s Election

author: Satviki Sanjay, Alex Gabriel Simon
description: India and the European Union concluded a long-awaited trade agreement, boosting prospects for Indian exporters while reshaping the competitive landscape for local manufacturers.
title: From Wine to Carmakers: Winners, Losers in India’s Giant EU Deal

author: Ellen Milligan
description: A widening defense spending gap is pushing the UK to rethink how it funds key contracts.
title: UK Looks to Private Capital to Help Fill Defense Spending Gap

description: British Prime Minister Keir Starmer is likely to be out of his role by the end of the year says Mujtaba Rahman, Europe Managing Director at Eurasia Group. On Starmer's wider Labour party, he added 'the polling is abysmal. They don’t have a clear narrative or a message for the country'. Rahman spoke to Bloomberg's Francine Lacqua on 'The Pulse' on January 26. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Eurasia Group: Starmer To Be Gone by End of Year

author: Saikat Das, Bhaskar Dutta
description: India and the European Union signed an accord to improve regulatory cooperation in financial services, according to a joint statement.
title: EU and India Sign Pact to Improve Financial Regulatory Ties

author: Jenni Marsh, Nectar Gan
description: The near-elimination of an entire generation of senior commanders has consequences.
title: Xi’s Purges Raise Questions Over Chinese PLA Capability

author: Brendan Murray
description: In less than three weeks, President Donald Trump has issued four sweeping tariff threats that, in normal times, would rattle investors, unnerve CEOs and send economists rushing to revise their growth forecasts for the targeted countries.
title: TACO Tracking: Trump Carries Out One in Four Tariff Threats

author: Gregory Korte
description: President Donald Trump is heading back to America’s heartland in an attempt to refocus an economic message that’s been upstaged by controversy over his deportation policies and the killing of two protesters by federal officers.
title: Minnesota Fury Risks Drowning Out Trump’s Focus on Economy

description: The European Union and India concluded a free trade agreement after nearly two decades of negotiations. The deal is expected to double EU goods exports to India by 2032 by eliminating or reducing tariffs on 96.6% of EU goods exports to India. The conclusion of negotiations after years of halting talks reflects the rapidly shifting global alignment under US President Donald Trump. Bloomberg’s Oliver Crook reports.
title: EU, India Reach Trade Deal After Nearly Two Decades

author: Petra Sorge
description: Economy Minister Katherina Reiche said the government expects German gross domestic product to expand by around 1% to 1.5% this year and next, underpinned by a surge in state outlays on infrastructure and defense.
title: German Economy Chief Sees GDP Growth of At Least 1% in 2026

author: Daniel Basteiro, Ainhoa Goyeneche
description: Spain’s unemployment rate dipped below 10% at the end of 2025, the lowest level in almost 18 years.
title: Spain’s Jobless Rate Drops Below 10% for First Time Since 2008

author: Weilun Soon
description: A group of 14 European nations have issued an open warning to shadow-fleet tankers in the Baltic and North Seas, raising the stakes for vessels they say are endangering maritime safety.
title: European Nations Issue Warning to Russia-Linked Shadow Fleet

author: Anisah Shukry
description: Malaysia’s government plans to do a cost-benefit analysis of its controversial trade agreement with the US, while warning lawmakers they should keep the accord despite concerns it may hurt the country.
title: Malaysia to Study US Trade Deal But Warns Against Quitting Pact

author: Zainab Fattah, Christine Burke, Laura Gardner Cuesta, Fiona MacDonald
description: Middle East businesses are watching tensions between Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates with increasing nervousness, concerned it could impact commerce at a time when both nations are emerging as powerhouses of regional trade and finance.
title: Saudi Arabia-UAE Tensions Put Middle East Businesses on Edge

author: Sanne Wass, Michael Nienaber
description: Denmark and Greenland’s leaders are in Berlin and Paris this week to shore up European backing after a framework deal with the US paved the way for negotiations on the Arctic island.
title: Denmark, Greenland Leaders Hold European Talks After US Deal

author: Alex Wickham, Damian Shepherd, James Woolcock
description: The government will cap ground rents paid by leaseholders in England and Wales despite concern about the impact on pension funds.
title: England’s Leasehold Ground Rents to Be Capped at £250-a-Year

author: Stephen Engle, Nectar Gan
description: The top US diplomat in China said Chinese President Xi Jinping’s purge of his most senior general is driven by his effort to both secure “total control” of his military and root out corruption.
title: Xi Seeks ‘Total Control’ of Military With Purge, Perdue Says

author: Myles Miller
description: Greg Bovino, the US Border Patrol commander who became the face of President Donald Trump’s sweeping immigration crackdown in Minneapolis, is leaving the city following a mounting public outcry over the killing of two US citizens by federal agents in recent weeks.
title: Trump’s Border Enforcer to Leave Minnesota After Backlash

author: Shruti Srivastava, Jorge Valero
description: The European Union and India concluded a free-trade agreement after almost two decades of negotiations, part of an effort to deepen economic ties that has gained momentum due to the Trump administration’s aggressive tariff policies.
title: EU and India Clinch ‘Mother of All Deals’ in Rebuff to Trump
